maintenanceAssessment: No Gradle module, compiler, runtime, or Android package dependency/version/closure changes. The two GOV.12 policy inputs are separately bound by the SHA-256 of gradle/policy/asset-pins.json and exact HTTPS NuGet flat-container URLs, package/member checksums, immutable producer commits and CI candidate evidence. ArcForges.Contracts.Validation contributes only its Apache-2.0 canonical naming data. ArcForges.Build.Policy is AGPL-3.0-only and is treated solely as a transient build-time carrier for its pinned portable JSON catalog: no .NET assembly is referenced or executed, and neither nupkg nor JSON enters source control or any APK/AAB. Existing runtime dependency locks and licence/resource closure remain unchanged.

closure-sbom.reason: The Gradle dependency graph and Android redistribution closure are unchanged; CI must rerun the actual locked-graph, licence and candidate gates alongside the new build-only data verifier.

compatibility.reason: No app/runtime dependency changes; existing Linux/Windows Gradle compilation and policy-task CI must prove the build remains compatible.

compilation.reason: The new Gradle Kotlin policy script is formatter-checked locally; the complete repository compilation and CI task graph remain required.

licence-provenance.reason: Mobile source provenance and the r10 resource-profile lineage pass locally; CI must rerun profile-history, Android licence closure and provenance checks with the pinned build-only assets.

local-runtime.reason: No Android runtime behavior or product binary changed; GOV.12 explicitly requires no device or emulator execution.

migration.reason: No persisted data, wire protocol or application behavior changed.

performance.reason: No build-time or app-runtime performance measurement was performed; no product runtime path changed.

security.reason: The build-time scanners and immutable asset staging are new policy gates; hosted security and full CI must verify the exact reviewed head.
